items.defectStatement: The restart guard checks multiprocessing.Process, which does not match the SpawnProcess workers created by the spawn context. Consequently, a hung worker is left alive while its replacement starts for the same shards, allowing concurrent flushing and duplicate output.
obligations: Invoke kill on unhealthy spawn-context workers before creating their replacements.
Avoid invoking process-only termination methods on threading.Thread workers.
Preserve replacement creation with the same process index and shards, including handling already-closed processes.
items.notes: Correcting the guard alone addresses the reported regression; joining additionally waits for termination and reaps the worker. A compatible process-base-class check or capability check is also valid.
